### About This Course

ISSS608 Visual Analytics and Applications is a graduate course at Singapore Management University (SMU) under the Master of IT in Business (MITB) programme. The course covers the principles and practice of visual analytics, including:

- 📊 Data visualisation using R and ggplot2
- 📈 Statistical and time-series graphics
- 🗺️ Geospatial visualisation
- 🖥️ Interactive dashboards with Shiny and plotly
